fun [timeoutMillis](timeout-millis.html)(timeoutMillis: [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html)?): [HttpOptions.Builder](index.html)

Sets [timeout](../../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-http-options/-builder/timeout.html) in milliseconds, or clears it when `null`. The non-null overload remains for binary compatibility and so Java `int` literals still compile.
